laundry-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: A supply hose, drain connection or appliance fault can release water onto a sound floor. That source requires separate plumbing or appliance attention; a new membrane does not repair the connection. Note whether dampness appears during filling, draining or while the machine is idle. Avoid disconnecting equipment just to collect evidence. We discuss the pattern and inspect accessible surfaces before deciding whether the floor build-up needs opening.

laundry-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.source: The laundry floor waste junction, where present, must be considered with surrounding falls, pipe penetrations and the wet area floor wall junction. We assess whether the existing base can support the selected system and how the work joins retained surfaces. Confirm who moves, disconnects and reinstates the washing machine, dryer or tub before work starts. The written quote separates removal and preparation from membrane work and the final tiled finish; concealed damage can change that scope after exposure.
laundry-waterproofing-adelaide.html/html.target: 已有地漏需结合周边坡度、管线穿透点及湿区墙地交接评估。我们检查现有基层能否支持所选系统及如何连接保留表面。开工前确认谁搬动、断开及复装洗衣机、烘干机或洗衣槽。报价分别列出拆除准备、膜层与最终贴砖；打开后发现的隐蔽损坏可能改变范围。
